title: Subscription Terms: Number of FilterDirect Subscriptions per Customer
content:
**Clause 1 — Number of subscriptions.** Under FilterDirect Filter Subscriptions a customer may hold up to 3 subscriptions, one for each filter return or filter size in the home.

**Clause 2 — Separate cycles.** Each subscription a customer holds is billed and shipped on its own cycle.

### The limit by grade

| Grade | Subscriptions one customer may hold |
|---|---|
| FilterDirect Standard MERV 8 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Pleated MERV 11 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Allergen MERV 13 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 11 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 13 | 3 |
| FilterDirect Media Cabinet MERV 16 | 3 |

The figure is the same for every grade, so the limit of 3 is read the same way whichever grades a household's subscriptions are in.

### Condition and result

| Subscriptions the customer already holds | Holding after one more sign-up | Within the limit of 3? |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 1 | Yes |
| 1 | 2 | Yes |
| 2 | 3 | Yes |
| 3 | 4 | No |

### Basis questions

**A household has a 1-inch return in the hallway and a second return of a different size upstairs. How are its filters subscribed?** Subscriptions are held one for each filter return or size in the home, so the household may hold one subscription for each of the two returns, and both count toward the limit of 3.

**Do two subscriptions of one customer share a billing date or a shipping cycle by virtue of belonging to the same customer?** No. Clause 2 places each subscription on its own billing and shipping cycle.
